status: HEURISTIC / UNVALIDATED research prototype. A prioritisation aid for clinician review. Not a diagnosis, not clinically validated as a whole.

evidence_legend.rfmid_validated: Image-model discrimination and the two operating points were validated on the RFMiD held-out test set (single centre, three cameras); see docs/MODEL_CARD.md. Not validated on any other population or camera.
evidence_legend.conventional_reference: Widely used clinical reference value or definition. Not validated as a risk predictor in this system.
evidence_legend.heuristic: Design choice of this prototype (points, caps, bands, combination matrix, overrides). Not fitted to any data and not validated against any outcome.

image.threshold_source_note: Thresholds are read from the model_meta stored with each prediction, so they always match the model that produced the score.

bands.I0: risk score below the screening threshold
bands.I1: risk score at/above the screening threshold but below the max-F1 threshold
bands.I2: risk score at/above the max-F1 threshold

image.evidence_note: The two thresholds are validated operating points; the meaning of the middle band I1 is not separately validated.

items.label: IOP > 21 mmHg
items.note: Conventional upper reference limit of intra-ocular pressure; not a diagnostic threshold.

items.label: Cup-to-disc ratio >= 0.6
items.note: Commonly used suspicion cut-off; depends on disc size.

items.label: Visual acuity < 0.3 (decimal)
items.note: WHO visual-impairment categories (6/18 = 0.3). Presenting vs corrected acuity is not distinguished.

items.label: Visual acuity < 0.5 (decimal)
items.note: WHO visual-impairment categories (6/12 = 0.5). Only the highest matching VA item counts.

items.label: Cup-to-disc ratio difference between eyes > 0.2
items.note: Commonly cited inter-eye asymmetry cut-off. Applied to both eyes.

items.label: Diabetes duration >= 10 years
items.note: Commonly used duration stratum for diabetic eye disease risk.

items.label: Blurred vision or floaters (non-specific, counted once)
Age >= 60 years
items.note: Common age cut-off in AMD / glaucoma epidemiology.

items.label: Family history (glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy or AMD)
Previous glaucoma, AMD or diabetic retinopathy

red_flags.label: IOP > 21 mmHg and cup-to-disc ratio >= 0.6 in the same eye
Visual field loss together with IOP > 21 mmHg or cup-to-disc ratio >= 0.6 in either eye

combination.note: Clinical findings can raise a tier by at most one level and never lower it. An eye without a usable image is never reported as Low.
